company.shortDescription: Hippo Scribe provides AI-assisted clinical documentation software for healthcare clinicians.
company.description: Hippo Scribe provides software for AI-assisted clinical documentation. The platform records patient visits or dictated notes and generates draft clinical notes. It supports customizable templates for physical therapists, pediatric speech-language pathologists, and pelvic health practitioners. The service integrates with web-based electronic medical record systems and is available through a browser extension. It offers individual and group plans with features such as unlimited visits, shared templates, and EMR integration.
